items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Mario was the interpreter; Mario was the Bauza interpreter with William Morris for Miguelito Valdes and Sacasas.

ctx.x: Well, when we worked at the Beachcomber, Sacasas got here with Miguelito, They had in mind to organize a band, both, but some kind of, I don't know, Miguelito always was, he want to be by himself, he don't want to take order from anybody, so ahh, and Sacasas had the same idea,

so Mario was the interpreter; Mario was the Bauza interpreter with William Morris for Miguelito Valdes and Sacasas. When Sacasas went to Ben Matthews' Riviera, Tito Puente played about two or three nights with us, with the Orquesta Siboney at Brick House, in forty-six between Sixth and Seventh, and he was about fourteen years old.
What was he playing, trap drums or timbales?
